marklong.hypesquad.name: HypeSquad Switcher
marklong.hypesquad.description: Switch your HypeSquad house (Bravery, Brilliance or Balance) or leave it with one tap from the plugin settings.
marklong.hypesquad.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.message-preview.name: Message Preview
marklong.message-preview.description: Adds a way to preview your message before sending it: a floating button over the message box, or hold the send button.
marklong.message-preview.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: nexpid (https://github.com/nexpid/RevengePlugins "Original Message Preview for Revenge, CC BY 4.0")

marklong.nef-viewer.name: NEF Viewer
marklong.nef-viewer.description: Shows Nikon RAW (.nef, .nrw) attachments as photos in chat instead of files.
marklong.nef-viewer.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.rich-presence.name: Rich Presence
marklong.rich-presence.description: Fully customizable rich presence: profiles, every activity field, images, timer, party size, buttons and live text variables. Shows nothing until you set it up.
marklong.rich-presence.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.role-options.name: Role Options
marklong.role-options.description: Adds Copy Role Name, Copy Role Color and Copy Role Icon to the role menu, and copies the color when you hold a role on a profile.
marklong.role-options.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: MSMA (https://github.com/Martinz64/vendetta-plugins "Original CopyRoleColor for Vendetta, public domain")

marklong.server-info.name: Server Info
marklong.server-info.description: Hold down a server icon and tap Server Info to see its members, roles, channels, boosts, owner, friends in it and more.
marklong.server-info.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: fshin (https://github.com/kmmiio99o/revenge-plugins "Original Server Info plugin for Revenge, CC0")

marklong.split-large-messages.name: Split Large Messages
marklong.split-large-messages.description: Automatically splits messages longer than 2000 (4000 with Nitro) characters into several messages.
marklong.split-large-messages.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.spotify-tools.name: Spotify Tools
marklong.spotify-tools.description: A Listen Along button on Spotify activities, and send what you are playing as a listen along invite, a song link or an album link from the + menu.
marklong.spotify-tools.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")

marklong.valid-user.name: Valid User
marklong.valid-user.description: Resolves @unknown-user mentions in messages and embeds automatically, no tap needed.
marklong.valid-user.author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
